notes.title: QoL features, bug fixes and more
notes.content:
The new patch (1.0.4c) includes:
[list]
[*][b]Stability fixes[/b]. crashes should be less common now.
[*][b]Summons are now ordered when you equip them[/b]. The summons in your active slots will always be at the top of the list
[*][b]You can now set "favourites" in your summons[/b]. This prevents them from being discarded and has an extra utility with the next feature
[*][b]You can discard all the "non-favourite" summons at once[/b]. This will give you all the materials from those discarded summons at the same time
[*][b]Added a setting to disable "Combat Assist"[/b]. Turning this off will make the character not turn to the locked target when using weapon attacks. Keep in mind that bows and Grimoires still will aim automatically to the target, as it's how those "tools" work.
[*][b]Fixed a couple of issues when monsters learnt new abilities:[/b] sometimes the Tactics were changed swapping the new ability for one the monster already has. Also, loading a game overwrote the elements of new abilities with the monster's own element, so it wasn't possible for monsters to learn other element attacks after saving and loading a game.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these changes!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes + Multiplayer tutorial
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a tutorial for Flask of Homunculus (go to "Intersection" and get the chest if you don't have it, if you picked the chest, the tutorial will appear automatically when you enter "Intersection")
[*]Fixed several attributes that weren't working properly
[*]Added a new functionality to Sensor attribute: if you kill a monster and approach it to resurrect it, you will see which kind of abilities does it have before getting it. This way, you can see if the monster has abilities (and which kind of abilities) or passive attributes
[*]Stability fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Classic ARPG Sword of the Necromancer is back, and it's even better than before
notes.content:
2024 was the year of ARPGs. Between Last Epoch and Path of Exile 2, we've seen plenty of dungeon crawlers slither out of the shadows in the past few years, each of which adds their own spin to the traditional demon slaying and build crafting experience. In the case of Sword of the Necromancer, the classic 2021 ARPG from Grimorio of Games, you can bend your foes to your will, resurrecting them to use as your own private army. Sitting at a 70% rating on Steam, Tama is back and better than ever in Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection, a brand new remaster that you can play right now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Multiplayer issue fix
notes.content: There was a crash when playing in multiplayer and trying to reset the multiplayer mode after dying against a boss

notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection Streaming
notes.content:
Don't miss the special streaming event for the new Steam Next Fest! 

You can also play the demo now!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782880/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Resurrection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877116/e638096dfa23e52d63967713f3cd2a6d31fded71.png[/img][/url]

[i][b]Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection[/b][/i] is a [b]reimagining of the original monster-summoning dungeon crawler game[/b], which featured top-down pixel art graphics. Based on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200940/Sword_of_the_Necromancer_Revenant/]Revenant's[/url] engine, players will be able to relive Tama's quest to resurrect her lover in 3D, with exciting new ways to battle and renewed mechanics and systems, including the possibility of customizing the summoned monsters' AI. This remake will also feature remastered high quality illustrations and voice acting (both in English and Japanese) and new scenes to delve deeper in Tama and Koko's tragic love story.

You can help us (a lot!) by wishlisting the game!
